Clinic Country Attended No-show Not yet recorded Total No-show rate Note Previous 30 days

No-show rate = (no-shows + not yet recorded) ÷ total, where total = attended + no-shows + not yet recorded. N/A: no appointments that day.

Assumed: appointments not yet marked as attended or missed are counted as missed. Clinics usually record no-shows from 08:00 the next day, so early in the morning most rates are assumed.

Previous 30 days: the same rate over the 30 days before the day shown, as a normal to compare the day against. For the first days of the data there are fewer earlier days, and the column header says how many.

All: every clinic together. A clinic that has closed is listed only on the days it had appointments.

Cancelled appointments are not counted.
